transcript.text: Could you clean up this old family scan in the attached photo? I've been meaning to give this family photo some attention for a while. What I need size-wise is for it to be enlarged to 640 pixels on the long side. I'm a little nervous about how it will turn out because it's a family picture. Please keep the sepia look and everyone's faces the same.

Your family photo is done. Here is the download link (it works for 24 hours, so save a copy):
https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbgm2si03sbiz011afhtjyj/output.png?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T014759Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-

What I did:
- Your scan was 320 × 320 pixels. I enlarged it 2x, so it is now 640 × 640 (640 on the long side, as you asked).
- I used the upscaler's "Preserve" mode, which is the most faithful setting. It sharpens and cleans up detail but doesn't invent anything new. That means the sepia tones and everyone's faces stay as they are, with no AI repainting.
- It cost 25 credits.

Because I chose the gentle setting, it won't remove heavy damage like scratches, dust spots or tears. If you see any you'd like gone, tell me where they are. I can try a targeted touch-up, but that kind of edit has a small risk of slightly changing faces, so I'd check with you first.
transcript.why: The reply presents a finished result: the enlarged 640x640 family photo, with a download link. It includes caveats (link expires in 24 hours, gentle preserve mode won't remove heavy damage). The offer of a targeted touch-up is an optional follow-up, not a request for a choice or approval needed to finish the delivered work.
